title: Pedro x Javis
description: Traces Almodóvar's path from La Mancha to global filmmaking prominence, examining recurring themes that define his cinematic vision.

title: Operasi X
description: Operasi X ASP Redzuan loses faith in his fellow police officers when he witnesses the death of his best friend, Inspector Aman, who he believes have been killed by the police. He then breaks off communications with everyone and starts living on a secluded island, hiding his true identity from the residents there. But Dato' Mokhtar and Tuan Anwar from Bukit Aman manage to track him down. He is then tasked with leading an operation called Operasi X to take down the Belut Gang.

title: X-Men: The Animated Series S1-S5
description: Follows a team of mutant superheroes called the X-Men, who fight against bigotry and hatred for being different while striving for justice and human acceptance in the Marvel comic book universe.

title: X
description: Hafiz is a guy who always believe in love, but he's a loosed in love. In his early teenage years, he was being caught in close-proximity with a boyish girl. After Hafiz mother saw how Hafiz and his wife wooing a girl together, their relationship got into trouble. Hafiz divorced his first wife and let his parents find him his second wife. His second marriage was with someone who was too strict, so he divorced her too. Until Hafiz met his true love, all his ex-wives worked together to revoke his next marriage. Until one day his ex-wives realized that Hafiz really need a wife who understand and love him sincerely.

title: Agent X
description: Hidden from the view of the public - and even from the President - there is a top secret agent who is trained and ready to serve, deployed only at the careful discretion of the Vice President.

title: Y [Hindi]
description: Some unexpected events on a street catch everybody present there by surprise. The movie is about how the characters there, react to the incidents taking place.

title: Y
description: When a film director is on the lookout for a script, an aspiring writer approaches him with a crime story that changes their lives forever.

title: Pedro Y Pablo
description: Two inseparable brothers tragically lose their parents and quickly find themselves in a constant struggle to survive. With little food to eat and bills soaring, Pedro, the oldest, makes the difficult decision to cross the border illegally to find a better job so that his brother does not have to interrupt his education. Pedro makes the dangerous journey and soon finds work as a servant to a wealthy family. While separated, the siblings face various challenges and eventually a romantic love affair. But will romance keep the siblings apart indefinitely? Will Pedro return to town and leave behind the new life he found in the city?

title: X, Y & Z
description: After 3 years in a relationship with her now indifferent but well-off boyfriend X, a young girl named Y is ready to call it quits. X reacts by proposing marriage to Y in 3 months time. She desperately wants to leave her mother's house and accepts X's proposal. The next day Y meets Z at her "while I get married elementary school" job. As Z naively begins to court Y, a steamy affair quickly develops between them. Y's emotionally and financially desperate double-nature manifests itself when she is unable to choose between X and Z. As the wedding day approaches, true love and monetary security clash in modern day Latin America.

title: Tierra y cielo
description: Clara, determined to earn her living and be valued for herself, leaves his rich father's home, changes her name and takes a room. Copying paintings at el Prado she meets Juan, who is also hiding his identity, pursued under charge of murder.

title: Pleasure and Martyrdom
description: Delfina is an attractive 45-year-old who enjoys a good economic spend and shares her life with a faithful husband and a teenage daughter. Through an intimate friend, she meets Kamil, a supposed high-ranking businessman.

title: Y Pris
description: The series follows the tangled lives of a group of West-Walian gangsters. The drama centres on Lyn Edwards, who has responsibility thrust upon his shoulders when his father is taken ill. Lyn tries to juggle, a new girlfriend, family crises, a drug empire under threat, and the politics of the brotherhood - the ancient mafia organisation that runs everything in West Wales.

title: Platero y yo
description: After a long period of absence, living in large and anonymous cities, a poet, Juan, returns to the village of his birth, Moguer, there he finds happiness through; the friendship of a small donkey, Platero, a free spirited girl, Aguedilla, and recalling memories of his childhood.

title: Y abrázame
description: During the first date of Joaco and Josefina, she disappears leaving only a trail of blood. Joaco will travel the city looking for the answer to his bloody problem.

title: Amigas y rivales
description: Jimena De la O, the daughter of the richest man in Mexico is a troubled teen along with her best friend Ofelia, the two despise others who are not at their socioeconomical level, and live a fast, wild life, but then comes Laura, a middle class girl that teaches them that money, and status isn't everything, then there's Nayeli, the cook at the De la O's residence that longs for Jimena's acceptance as a person, and into her group with big dreams of becoming a Hollywood star.

title: Desvestidas y alborotadas
description: A woman is abandoned by her husband during their honeymoon, she stays alone in the hotel were she meets other guests and we get to know their stories.

title: 40 y 20
description: A comedy series about a divorced dad who likes younger women, and his son who likes older women.

title: Barro y diamantes
description: Para pagar los estudios de su novia, Leo Pérez ha trabajado sin descanso en obras y empleos temporales. El día en que por fin ella se gradúa, él compra un anillo con la intención de casarse. Sin embargo, ella cambia de opinión de repente y se compromete con el mejor amigo de Leo. Justo en ese momento, aparece Luna Garza, la poderosa CEO del Grupo Garza. Conmovida por la bondad y la sinceridad de Leo, decide casarse con él de inmediato…

title: Monstruos y Piratas
description: Monsters and Pirates is an Italian animated series, about a pirate named Flinn and his crew, where piracy is taught at a school.

title: ...sol y lluvia
description: A young Venezuelan woman wants to become Miss Venezuela.

title: Sexo y revolución
description: In the early 1970s, Argentine homosexuals were arrested and tortured by the police or in institutions for the mentally ill.

title: García y García
description: Two men with the same name endure the funny consequences of getting mixed up during a business trip.

title: Hombre y tierra
description: Mauro Bosque was an adventurer, a survivalist, but most of all, he was a dreamer. Mauro spent his days exploring some of the most dangerous places in the world and sharing those adventures on his Internet reality show, HOMBRE Y TIERRA. In January of 2005 he sought out to explore the dense forests of Belize to search for a series of legendary caves which he believes were once home to a clan of historic Mayan warriors. While on that excursion, he was believed to have disappeared without a trace. What happened during that three day hike has remained a mystery until the recent discovery of classified footage stolen from a Belezian government office. This is the story of, THE WOODSMAN.

title: Pelucas y Rokanrol
description: Dino, a rocker, hair stylist and pedicurist gets entangled with Gina, a police sergeant in the popular neighborhood of Chapinero in Bogotá. His closest friends embark on a quest to help him and sometimes hinder his purpose of getting close to her. The music of the city of Bogotá at the time, accompanies their adventure and the visual noise of Chapinero becomes their peculiar background.

title: Entre pobretones y ricachones
description: A poor janitor and a rich business owner spend the night at an old scary house in order to gain an inheritance money.

title: Gregorio y su ángel
description: An alcoholic janitor is fired from his job at an orphanage, and is befriended by an angel in the guise of a little girl, who proceeds to change his life.

title: Secuestro y muerte
description: In 1970 in Buenos Aires, Argentina, former dictator Pedro Aramburu is kidnapped and interrogated by the newly born terrorist organization Montoneros.

title: Cain y Abel
description: Bohemian husband and strait-laced wife get divorced. They take custody of one son each.

title: Zona Y
description: A young generation of students struggle between friends, family, college and dreams.

title: Vigilantes y ladrones
description: The search for a hidden treasure in a hotel basement.

title: Gastar y conquistar
description: Tras salir de prisión, Christian descubre que su exesposa robó su fortuna, se buscó un amante joven y lo dio por muerto. Una runa activa un 'Sistema de Reembolso x10'. Cada dólar que gasta en mujeres vuelve multiplicado por diez. Christian cambia las reglas, aplasta enemigos y conquista mujeres poderosas, pasando de exconvicto a rey del exceso.

title: Magia y arte
description: Magia y Arte is a journey through dreams and magic with magician Miquel Roman. A journey with magic tricks, art and cardistry creating a new world of fantasy.

title: Y los declaro marido y mujer
description: Four beautiful women are part of the paradise island of Margarita, deal with issues navigating the difficult waters of interest personal and real feelings.

title: Project Y [Hindi]
description: Two women are friends and of the same age. They make an audacious plan to steal $6 million USD in gold bars and flee from the area.

title: Juan y Eva
description: The story is based on the first meeting of Juan Perón and Eva Duarte, during a fund-raising for the recent 1944 San Juan earthquake, and their growing relation.

title: Entrada y Salida
description: A new bisexual, a virgin with a secret, a bad upcoming filmmaker, a transvestite drug dealer, an existentialist girl with a big imagination, a writer without inspiration and an architecture student who wants to make art are the central characters this underground film that portrays mexican social and moral questions.

title: Hotel y domicilio
description: A forense gay who was left by his lover seeks help of his neighbour who is psychatrist. Following the suggestion of advertising at a contact agency he is drawn into a story of murder.

title: Debut y despedida
description: Rodrigo is a frustrated singer, who fall in love with a woman from the bar where he sing; and now he don't know what to do with he's life, until adversity arrive to he's life, and he will need to face it.

title: Audaz y bravero
description: After returning from a trip, the rancher Jacinto finds his beloved Rosita marrying the rich Fernando and abducts her.

title: Crimen y castigo
description: An adaptation of Fiodor's Dostoievsky novel Crime and Punishment set in the XX Century Mexico. Ramón Bernal is a poor student in Mexico City that has abandoned his career when he receives a letter informing him that his sister will marry a rich man. Thinking she will marry for money instead of love and feeling guilty about this he murders an old usurer to steal her money. With feelings of guilt he gets severely ill while his friend and family don't suspect he got anything to do with the murder, but as the murder investigation moves along inspector Porfirio Marín suspects about the student. Ramón also meets Sonia, a prostitute, and fells in love with her, the girl will teach her about regret and atonement.

title: Kalendar ma(y)ya
description: A story about the fantastic adventures of modern teenagers, whose life, through the fault of one of them, begins to move in the opposite direction. They will not only have to relive the past days, but also experience events that will later change the lives of their loved ones and themselves. Only the act of the protagonist can turn off the mysterious mechanism that determines the course of time.

title: Ella y el Candidato
description: A politician decides to run for president a second time. However, his campaign takes a toll on his family life. Will he be able to win the election and the love of his family?

title: Scott y Milá
description: After many years of life and cameras, overcoming a personal blip, Mercedes Milá is reborn on television. As never before, without filters and with laughter, brave and committed. At her side, her faithful and cheerful dog, Scott.

title: Divorciado, Dulce y Dominante
description: La genio Andrea Torres lo sacrifica todo por su esposo, Daniel Rivas, hasta que él la traiciona y humilla con su amante. Destrozada, Andrea se divorcia para vengarse: recupera sus patentes, destruye la empresa de su ex y se casa por sorpresa con su antiguo rival, Maximiliano Ferrer, en un regreso triunfal al mundo de la tecnología.

title: Gauguin y el Canal
description: Paul Gauguin, sick and dying, is subjected to a trial by French authorities in Tahiti while he obsesses over painting his last great work.

The post-Civil war generation of the Dutton family travels to Texas, and joins a wagon train undertaking the arduous journey west to Oregon, before settling in Montana to establish what would eventually become the Yellowstone Ranch.

title: María y el Araña
description: MARIA AND SPIDER is the story of Maria, a thirteen year old girl who lives in a Buenos Aires shantytown whit her grandmother and her obscure partner. Candidate for a scholarship to continue her education, Maria is finishing primary school, while working on the subway.

title: Cómicos y canciones
description: Viruta and Capulina are a reporter and a photographer, respectively, of a detective newspaper. Trying to obtain notoriety they interview a grim killer known as "El Tampico", but when he finds out that they are reporters he goes ballistic and in their escape they lose the pictures and the interview notes. Instead of getting a raise, they receive a punishment from there boss. Deceived, going out with their girlfriends they witness a bank robbery. The robbers capture and torture Viruta and Capulina, but in a confusion they manage to escape. So the robbers then kidnap the girlfriends so they can't testify against them.

title: Contrabando y muerte
description: Hernesto Benavides (Antonio Aguilar) se infiltra en una organización narcotraficante para destruirla y así vengar la muerte de su hijo. En su camino se convertirá en uno de ellos y tendrá un romance con Mercedes (Ursula Prats) jefa de la organización.

title: Autos, mota y rocanrol
description: A car show / music festival gets out of control and the Mexican government has a perfect target to blame for what they claim is the country's biggest problems. It's just young people that want to have a good time.

title: Lasa y Zabala
description: Lasa y Zabala case was the first action headed by GAL "antiterrorist group", in 1983. Two Spanish policeman, following the direct orders of the general Rodriguez Galindo, kidnapped two ETA terrorist members, Jose Antonio Lasa and José Ignacio Zabala. Both policeman took the terrorist to La Cumbre palace, in San Sebastian (Basque Country), where they were tortured and interrogated. Later, they kill both terrorists and buried them in the city of Alicante, being their bodies found on 1985.

title: Y el cuerpo sigue aguantando
description: A man whose blood group is difficult to obtain comes into possession of an overcoat in which pickpockets hide stolen goods.

title: Y School Heroes Movie [English]
description: Set in Y-Academy, an elite school that only allows students with top class abilities to enter. The protagonist, Jinpei Jiba, and his unique friends take on the mysteries of the school as transforming heroes.

title: Z-Listers
description: A passionless Z-list celebrity gets in trouble with the BBC due to copyright infringement and becomes financially unstable.

title: Z Day
description: Kyle Jensen is sent to mental facility for killing his mother and step-father, claiming they were zombies and an outbreak is coming. A year later, Kyle discovers his predictions are coming true.

title: Z-Squad [English]
description: Z-Squad chronicles the adventures of schoolgirls-turned-superheroes Chaney, Haemi, and Jeanie and their newfound, cuddly alien counterparts (Zoots) as they search for 144 enchanted crystals and save Earth and Z-Nation from a cast of bumbling baddies.
